title: A Defender in Name Only
setup: Your rook on b6 cuts along the sixth rank, through the black c-pawn, all the way to the king on f6.
hint: One black pawn defends the rook on d5. Check what your own rook on b6 is doing to that pawn first.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Rxd5}} wins a full rook. The pawn on **c6** is the only defender of d5, but it is pinned along the sixth rank by your rook on **b6**: if it captures, the king on **f6** stands in check. A pinned pawn defends nothing.
